_comment: TTS 교체 후보 비교용 대사. fish = Fish S2 Pro 인라인 태그(자유 서술형 [ ]), higgs = Higgs TTS 3 제어 토큰, zonos = ZONOS2 감정 슬라이더(happy/sad/angry/surprised) + valence/arousal 축, qwen = Qwen3 VoiceDesign 줄별 감정 지시(캐릭터 instruct 뒤에 붙음).

lines.text: 근데 왜 살아서… 왜 내 옆에서… 왜 날 구해 줬는데!
lines.qwen: She is screaming through tears with a knife in her hand, furious and heartbroken, voice cracking.

lines.text: …나, 선배 좋아했단 말이야. 오빠 생긴 것 같았단 말이야.
lines.qwen: She breaks down sobbing, betrayed and heartbroken, words choked by tears.

lines.text: 강해온은 너무 쉽게 죽었어. 바다에 빠져서 끝? 그게 벌이야?
lines.qwen: Bitter, trembling, suppressed rage, spitting the words out with contempt.
Crying uncontrollably, ashamed and broken, voice shaking and fading.
Trembling, desperate plea, almost whispering, on the verge of tears.

lines.text: 너 같은 부잣집 애가 뭘 알아! 집이 넘어가는 게 뭔지 알아?
lines.qwen: His polite manner collapses, shouting in raw anger and humiliation.

lines.text: 원하는 대로 해. 어차피 난 늘 개였으니까.
lines.qwen: Resigned and self-loathing, bitter quiet voice, choked with tears.

lines.text: 안에 사람이 있는 줄 몰랐어. 진짜 몰랐어.
lines.qwen: His arrogance gone, crying and panicked, confessing in a shaking desperate voice.

lines.text: 내 배에서 내려. 다음에 보면 진짜 재미없을 거야.
lines.qwen: Cold and menacing, low threatening voice, barely contained anger.

lines.text: 돈 있는 사람들은 다 똑같아. 웃으면서 사람을 깔보지.
lines.qwen: Icy contempt, sharp and cutting, hiding hurt behind coldness.

lines.text: 선생님… 대답해요. 제발. 대답 좀 해요…!
lines.qwen: A terrified boy in a burning building, crying and begging desperately, voice breaking.
Calm, smiling, utterly menacing and condescending, slow and deliberate.
